claim_or_topic: VSL definition and uniform nationwide policy
source_title: Departmental Guidance on Valuation of a Statistical Life in Economic Analysis
notes: Current page lists $14.2M for a 2025 base year; re-check dollar value before release.

claim_or_topic: VSL methodology and risk-reduction meaning
source_title: Treatment of the Value of Preventing Fatalities and Injuries in Preparing Economic Analyses
notes: Defines VSL as valuation of mortality-risk reductions rather than life as such; applies one nationwide value regardless of age or income.

claim_or_topic: QALYs in health technology cost-effectiveness
source_title: Technology appraisal and highly specialised technologies guidance: the manual — Economic evaluation
author_or_institution: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
notes: QALYs reflect mortality and health-related quality of life; NICE links cost-effectiveness to a fixed NHS/PSS budget.

claim_or_topic: DALY definition and methodological value choices
source_title: WHO methods and data sources for global burden of disease estimates 2000–2019
notes: DALYs combine YLL and YLD; simplified method removed time discounting and unequal age weights.

claim_or_topic: Common-pool resource governance and institutional diversity
source_title: Interview with Elinor Ostrom and Oliver E. Williamson
notes: Ostrom describes durable commons institutions and design principles while rejecting a single universal rule set.

claim_or_topic: Catch-share allocation as one fishery-management option
source_title: Catch Shares
notes: Defines catch shares as allocations of total allowable catch and explicitly says they are not appropriate for every fishery.

claim_or_topic: Annual catch limits and accountability measures
source_title: Ending Overfishing Through Annual Catch Limits
notes: Federal fisheries use annual catch limits and accountability measures to prevent or correct overfishing.

claim_or_topic: Antibiotic resistance as a shared intertemporal health risk
source_title: Global antibiotic resistance surveillance report 2025
notes: Reports global resistance prevalence and trends from GLASS data; supports stewardship without implying all antibiotic use is misuse.

claim_or_topic: Antimicrobial use surveillance and stewardship
source_title: GLASS guide on use of national data on antimicrobial use
notes: Frames preserving antimicrobial effectiveness around surveillance and appropriate access/use rather than blanket reduction.

claim_or_topic: Liver allocation scores and exception architecture
source_title: Questions and Answers About Liver Allocation
notes: Explains MELD/PELD baseline scores, standardized exceptions, and review for conditions poorly represented by the calculation.

claim_or_topic: National review of liver exception requests
source_title: Liver Review Board Guidance
notes: Documents evidence guidance for reviewing adult and pediatric MELD/PELD exception requests.

claim_or_topic: Equity rationale for standardized exception review
source_title: National Liver Review Board
notes: Explains the move from regional variability toward national review when calculated MELD/PELD does not reflect disease severity.

claim_or_topic: Reasonable accommodation and undue hardship
source_title: Job Applicants and the ADA
notes: Accommodation can modify application or work methods while remaining bounded by undue-hardship and qualification requirements.

claim_or_topic: Individualized accommodation examples and essential functions
source_title: Fact Sheet: Disability Discrimination
notes: Shows why equal opportunity can require different methods for different disabilities; employers need not lower essential standards.

claim_or_topic: Advisory federal sentencing guidelines and variances
source_title: Annotated 2025 Chapter 1
notes: After Booker courts may impose sentences outside the guideline range as variances under statutory factors; current manual reflects shift away from departures.

claim_or_topic: AI governance transparency explainability and accountability
source_title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
author_or_institution: National Institute of Standards and Technology
notes: Voluntary rights-preserving framework distinguishes transparency explainability and interpretability; NIST says 1.0 is being revised in 2026 so re-check current version before release.

claim_or_topic: Specific reasons for adverse credit actions using complex algorithms
source_title: Consumer Financial Protection Circular 2022-03
notes: ECOA and Regulation B require specific and accurate principal reasons even when a creditor uses a complex algorithm; opacity is not a defense.

claim_or_topic: Algorithmic employment tools and disability screening
source_title: Artificial Intelligence and the ADA
notes: EEOC warns that algorithmic tools can screen out qualified people with disabilities and emphasizes reasonable-accommodation processes.

claim_or_topic: AI assessments and visual disability accommodations
source_title: Visual Disabilities in the Workplace and the Americans with Disabilities Act
notes: Questions 16–17 explain that AI assessments may mismeasure applicants with visual disabilities and may require an alternative format as reasonable accommodation.

claim_or_topic: Ireland Citizens' Assembly recommendations on abortion law
source_title: 22 April 2017 meeting and ballots

claim_or_topic: Referendum result and role of Citizens' Assembly

claim_or_topic: Representative deliberative process design
source_title: OECD Guidelines for Citizen Participation Processes
notes: Defines representative deliberative processes around representative selection, learning, deliberation, recommendations, and public-authority response.
